text.tspan: Character model sheet / turnaround of Bram: front, three-
quarter, side, and back views at consistent height, plus three
facial expressions, neutral plain background. Character: BRAM:
human boy 8, tall lanky build, pale olive skin, floppy dark
brown curls (#3e2723), wide warm brown eyes (#6d4c41) behind
round wire glasses (#d7ccc8), mint-green pocket-covered tunic
(#c7b8ea) dragging, pockets bulging with jars/chalk/string, one
sleeve rolled higher, nervous concentrated expression counting
on fingers. dreamy pastel children's book illustration, soft
blush and mint palette, whisper-thin rounded lines, golden-hour
glow with floating magic motes, ethereal gradients, hand-painted
paper texture, cozy whimsical mood, no text. palette: cream
